scope: Character motion definitions for Furb-o-Mek and the current evidence for their constituent moves. This catalog grants no actuator authority.

tabletop_video.camera: Fixed oblique Logitech C930e, 640 × 480, 15 fps, flashlight
tabletop_video.method: Match chassis features to the pose immediately before each command, subtract background motion and cross-check with two independently selected chassis regions. Use the median of twelve settled video frames when available. Frame indices are zero-based and inclusive.
tabletop_video.coordinates: Screen right and down are positive. Projected clockwise rotation is positive. Values are image displacement, with no metric scale or table dimensions.
tabletop_video.limits: One trial per guard action. Some feet were obscured. Guard elapsed time and video settling time are independent.

expressive_supported_pass.scope: One supervised pass with the chassis supported. No new tabletop qualification.

reduced_preflight_supported_pass.scope: One supervised supported pass, with all four actions completed and verified DISARM.

hermes_bare_table_pass.scope: Actual profile MCP, supervised bare table, same power-up.

hermes_bare_table_poke_front_view.scope: One additional supervised Poke with a low front view.

larger_expressive_supported_pass.scope: Larger installed Mega gestures, one supervised supported pass with visible movement and verified normal DISARM.

supported_bench.sleep: Verified guard completion and DISARM with the chassis supported. Operator confirmed the movement. No quantified stance or leg fold was recorded.

active.result: Legs extend and the chassis rises. The vertical screen shift is a height proxy.

forward.result: Forward travel across both alternating tripod phases.

backward.result: Reverse travel, with some recoil toward the starting position before settling.

left.result: Predominantly lateral travel with a small accompanying turn.

right.result: Lateral travel in the opposite direction from Left.

turn_left.result: Counterclockwise rotation. The first snapshot missed the settled turn.

turn_right.result: Clockwise rotation visible at the end of the recording. Settled rotation is unknown.

scuttle.intent: A short burst of quick alternating steps followed by a clear stop.
scuttle.evidence: One two-phase forward cycle moved about 27 px in 1.81 s. This is the baseline; pace and chained cycles remain to be measured.
scuttle.next_measurement: Measure alternating steps, no-load and loaded cadence, forward travel, yaw drift, peak and stopping excursion. Compare cadence against a normal Forward on the same surface before naming a distinct speed preset.

strafe_left.intent: Move left relative to the body while maintaining heading.
strafe_left.evidence: One observed phase moved roughly 11 px laterally with about 2° of projected turn.
strafe_left.next_measurement: Check both starting tripod phases and score lateral travel, forward drift and yaw separately.

strafe_right.intent: Move right relative to the body while maintaining heading.
strafe_right.evidence: One observed phase moved roughly 10 px laterally with about 0.6° of projected turn.
strafe_right.next_measurement: Check both starting tripod phases and score lateral travel, forward drift and yaw separately.

heighten.intent: Rise out of the low stance into the normal standing pose.
heighten.evidence: Active extended the legs. The chassis rose about 7 px in projection over the tabletop pass.
heighten.next_measurement: Measure rise, settle and ground contact from a low side or oblique view. A taller-than-normal pose requires a separate bounded preset and its own trial.

poke.intent: Lift one front foot, reach into clear air, retract and replant it once.
poke.end_pose: Standing with all six feet planted
poke.evidence: The supported and bare-table Guard requests verified DISARM. The low front Kinect view on the bare-table repeat measured roughly 4 px of sideways motion and 3 px residual shift in the screen-left foot region. The lift and forward reach were not resolved.
poke.next_measurement: Score reach, lift, return placement, support from the other five feet, and chassis drift. A controlled test needs an unobstructed view of the reaching foot.

defensive_posture.intent: Lower and widen in a short brace, then return to the starting stance.
defensive_posture.evidence: The supported brace completed with verified DISARM in 2310 ms and about 11 px peak image travel. A bare-table run through Hermes verified DISARM, with about 7 px near-front travel and return.
defensive_posture.next_measurement: Score chassis drop, stance width, foot contact, drift and return to standing as a separate transition.

curl_up.intent: Lower the chassis and bring the legs inward into a compact rest.
curl_up.evidence: Sleep lowered the chassis about 7 px on the tabletop. Tuck Preview verified DISARM in the supported pass with about 15 px near-front travel. It later verified DISARM on the bare table through Hermes, with about 9 px near-front travel and return.
curl_up.next_measurement: Map the compact leg fold as a separate bounded pose and score the change in footprint independently of chassis height.

recoil.intent: One short retreat followed by a settled pose.
recoil.evidence: One observed reverse phase moved about 12 px after settling.
recoil.next_measurement: Measure repeatability, peak reverse travel and slip between first motion and settle.
